b6d8f9da3047891c179408bf937652d24d430b40.summary: IBM X-Force Research report (published 2016-08-16) on Zeus Sphinx, a commercial Zeus v2 banking Trojan variant. Sphinx v2 was found targeting online banking and Boleto payments of Brazilian and Colombian banks, and it can reroute Boleto payments to criminal-controlled accounts. The report links Sphinx v2 to the same developer as the original Sphinx, expects more variants, and cites one estimate of $3.75 billion in Boleto fraud losses.
